title: Identity derived self symmetry of an even shifted flat object
statement: In a braided Grothendieck abelian monoidal closed category with functorial flat resolutions, let J be flat and have identity ordinary self braiding. The canonical derived self symmetry of the single of J in degree zero shifted by 2d is identity for every integer d. The canonical symmetry is that of [lem-kun-tensor-sym].

proof.text: For a single complex in even degree n, use total-tensor coproduct extensionality. Every summand except bidegree (n,n) has zero source. The explicit Koszul braiding on that summand is the ordinary braiding multiplied by (-1)^(n*n); evenness makes this sign one. Naturality along singleObjXSelf transports the assumed ordinary self braiding.

proof.text: The single complex is K-flat since J is flat. The quotient preserves its identity braiding. Compatibility braiding_hom_mu identifies the derived braiding followed by the Qh tensor comparison with the comparison followed by Qh of the homotopy braiding. The comparison is invertible for this K-flat object, so cancellation gives identity.

lean.statement:
theorem evenShiftCanonicalSelfSymmetry
    {C : Type*} [Category.{u + 1} C] [Abelian C]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} C]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalClosed C]
    [BraidedCategory C] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution C]
    (J : C) (hflat : ObjectProperty.flat J) (hJ : (β_ J J).hom = 𝟙 _) (d : ℤ) :
    let L := ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj J)⟦(2 * d : ℤ)⟧
    ((_root_.DerivedCategory.canonicalTensorSymmetry C).hom.app L).app L = 𝟙 _
